annotations.title: Get PropGuardian Drawdown & Kelly Sizing Status

description: Returns live systematic risk telemetry for prop challenge pacing: trailing drawdown kill-switch headroom, daily loss usage, and Bayesian Kelly allocation sizing.

daily_loss_limit_pct.description: Prop firm maximum daily loss limit percentage (e.g. 5.0 for 5%).

firm_preset.description: Firm risk model preset: 'FTMO' (Static Daily), 'Topstep' (EOD Trailing), 'Apex' (Intraday Peak Trailing), or 'Custom'.

stop_loss_pips.description: Planned stop loss distance in pips for dynamic position sizing.
